summary: Fixed the AR/OLS shard in statsmodels/tsa/ar_model.py and shared helpers: added Model._check_kwargs, the AR fittedvalues/resid and conf_int wrapping, apply summary text and forecast ndarray return, append type/exog checks, get_prediction positions with hold_back padding, integer dynamic offsets, a seasonal drop order in deterministic.py, and a labelled-column fallback in base/data.py attach_columns. The last run I saw was statsmodels/tsa/tests/test_ar.py (not the full suite, which I did not run): 3883 passed, 1 failed (test_dynamic_against_sarimax, which depends on statespace FilterResults dynamic prediction returning a truncated array and was not fixed here).
